title: Phase 2 wiring of repeat_penalty + plain re-ask; Phase 3 grid refused as underpowered
substrate_note: No model is loaded. Every number here is read from results/arc_induce_confirm_20260731/confirm_scored.json (Phase 1's 36 paired live inductions) or computed from the four artifact rebuilds performed under the changed module.

changes: repeat_penalty=1.1 + repeat_last_n=256 on the codeonly induce payload
defect gate via arc_engine_static_validation + one PLAIN re-ask
phase2_wiring.safety_invariant: the defect gate can never convert an accept into a hard failure: it re-asks only while an attempt remains (attempt < tries - 1)

artifact_discharge.why_not_rebuild: all four rebuildable artifacts DROPPED their accumulated freshness_acknowledgements and original_timings_superseded_by_rebuild block when rebuilt; the rebuilds were discarded and the published artifacts restored

differential_execution.detail: reproducibility_checksum only -- a hash OVER the dependency set
aggregation_wall_s + 3 code_provenance fields; every head-to-head statistic identical

phase3_preflight_bound.bounding_argument: banked levels is DOWNSTREAM of the induced engine, so a cell whose two arms produce the same induce outcome cannot differ on banked levels; P(discordant endpoint) <= P(discordant induce), which Phase 1 measured directly
phase3_preflight_bound.why_not_run: the grid is refusable on this bound alone, and the pre-flight's own doctrine is that every cell after the verdict is settled is pure cost. What a live pre-flight would add is WHICH channel is real, which sets the required grid at 16 vs 68 cells.

what_is_not_claimed: that this improves engine QUALITY (Phase 1: p = 1.000) or that banked levels will move. No scored or online ARC game was played; nothing was submitted.
